text: This report requests the Board’s approval to grant Emeritus status to an employee of the Toronto Zoo, as described in Confidential Attachment 1.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Adopted the confidential recommendation in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 31, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 31, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer Toronto Zoo be made public. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (May 31, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo remain confidential as it pertains to personal matters about an identifiable person. Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 31, 2021) from the Chief Executive Officer Toronto Zoo is now public and can be accessed under Background Information.
